notes.title: Patch 18 MAR 2025
notes.notes: French localization is now available, thanks to Sykoo! A huge thank you!

notes.title: Patch 3 FEB 2025
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that caused text to be misaligned when opening the options menu.

notes.title: Korean Translation (Patch 30 JAN 2025)
notes.notes:
- The game has now a Korean translation available.
- Thanks to JW (intothereign)

notes.title: Small Patch 26 JAN 2025
notes.notes: Descriptions from Linked List and MEM4 Emulator have been slightly modified for improved clarity.

notes.title: Patch 9 JAN 2025
notes.notes:
While a histogram is downloading, an ellipsis will appear in the top-left corner of the histograms screen. Once the download is complete, the screen will display the number of scores downloaded. If this number is less than 9,999, it will also represent the number of players who completed that level.
 Corrected typos in the Quick Reference Guide.
 Fixed a visual bug affecting certain GIFs.
 Updated the conditions for triggering the "Mind of a Machine" achievement.
 Did you know you can hold down Q while recording GIFs to hide UBITs?

notes.title: Patch 8 JAN 2025
notes.notes:
- I clarified how OE functions in the Pairer level with an example page.
- I added explanatory text to the Signal Counter level.
- I updated the quick reference guide to include utilities that mirror the information available in the miscellany icon.
- GIFs have a 25% longer duration but use fewer colors, giving them a more retro appearance.

notes.title: Hotfix 29 DEC 2024
notes.notes: - Solved a minor bug affecting number input on icons.

notes.title: Patch 24 NOV 2024
notes.notes:
Added a quick access button for the online manual in the options menu (accessible by pressing ESC). The offline version is in the installation folder.
 The Sandbox is available after completing 8 levels.

notes.title: Patch 23 NOV 2024
notes.notes:
Updated the description of "Color Test II" to emphasize key concepts.
 Added an example to "Linked List" to enhance understanding of the task.
 Fixed the F12 functionality to correctly capture a screenshot for sharing on Steam.

notes.title: Patch 22 NOV 2024
notes.notes:
Added collision examples to the level "Seizer" to clarify how collisions work.
 New icons now feature a red mark to make them more noticeable. 
 Updated the level description for "Color test I" to improve clarity.

notes.title: Patch 20 NOV 2024
notes.notes: - Introduced an optional hint system for the first four levels (tutorial) to enhance accessibility.

notes.title: Patch 18 NOV 2024
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:


  You can now press ALT + 1/2/3 to quickly select a wire type.
  Levels with completed challenges are now marked in the main menu for easier tracking.
  If errors occur during a simulation, stopping it will keep the game on the same test case for easier debugging.
